title: Centella asiatica tincture for medicinal use
intro: Centella asiatica tincture is a concentrated liquid extract made from the leaves of the Centella asiatica plant, commonly known as gotu kola. It is traditionally used in herbalism to support cognitive function, reduce stress, and promote skin health. The tincture is often taken orally to enhance mental clarity and alleviate symptoms of anxiety or depression. It is also applied topically to aid in wound healing and reduce the appearance of scars. This preparation is valued for its adaptogenic properties and is used in both traditional and modern holistic medicine.
